summary.text: Ed Gallrein is the Republican nominee for Kentucky's 4th Congressional District. A retired Navy SEAL officer and fifth-generation farmer, he ran for the state Senate in 2024 and lost the primary, then won the 2026 Republican primary against incumbent Thomas Massie with President Trump's endorsement. His campaign website lists cutting taxes and regulation, border security, gun rights, and opposition to abortion as priorities.

paragraphs.text: Born in 1958; his campaign website says he was born and raised in Kentucky and is a fifth-generation farmer whose family has worked the land for over a century.

Earned a bachelor's degree in agriculture from Murray State University in 1981 and a master's degree in agribusiness economics in 1984, according to Wikipedia. It also lists master's degrees from the Naval Postgraduate School and the Air War College.

Served in the U.S. Navy from 1984 to 2014 as a SEAL officer, rising to the rank of Captain, according to his campaign website and Wikipedia. His campaign says he served on seven SEAL teams or units, including SEAL Team Six, and deployed from Panama to the Persian Gulf.
His campaign website lists three Bronze Star Medals and two Presidential Unit Citations among his military awards.

After leaving the Navy he returned to Kentucky as a farmer and business owner, according to his campaign website; Wikipedia states he has operated Circle G Farm and Stables in Shelby County since 2014.
Ran in the May 2024 Republican primary for Kentucky State Senate District 7 and finished second, receiving 38.3% to Aaron Reed's 39.3%. Before the 2026 race he had never held elective office.
Entered the 2026 race in October 2025 after President Trump endorsed him, and defeated incumbent Thomas Massie in the May 19, 2026 Republican primary, 54.9% to 45.1%.

sources.title: Trump-endorsed candidate enters race to challenge Republican Rep. Thomas Massie of Kentucky
